title: Second silent object seen by three witnesses

tellings.quote: The The second object that came a few weeks later was was was different structure. Um completely silent observed by three witnesses. My My ranch security and surveyor along with my caretakers of the time.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, says that around 2016 a second unknown object appeared there a few weeks after a first one. According to him it had a different shape, made no sound at all, and was seen by three people: his ranch security man and surveyor, plus his caretakers of the time. He tells it as part of a pattern of unexplained craft over the ranch.
